hooks.command: PATH="/usr/local/bin:/opt/homebrew/bin:$PATH"; command -v jq >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo 'BLOCK: jq is required by the protected-file guard' >&2; exit 2; }; f=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty'); case "$f" in */.env.example) exit 0;; */.env|*/.env.*|*pnpm-lock.yaml|*/node_modules/*|*/.next/*|*/dist/*) echo "BLOCK: $f is a protected file" >&2; exit 2;; esac; exit 0

PATH="/usr/local/bin:/opt/homebrew/bin:$PATH"; command -v jq >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 0; c=$(jq -r '.tool_input.command // empty' | sed 's/\.env\.example//g'); if printf '%s' "$c" | grep -Eq '(>[[:space:]]*[^[:space:]]*|(^|[^A-Za-z0-9_])(rm|mv|cp|tee|truncate|sed[[:space:]]+-i[^[:space:]]*|perl[[:space:]]+-[a-zA-Z]*i[^[:space:]]*)([^A-Za-z0-9_]).*)(\.env(\.[A-Za-z0-9_.-]+)?|pnpm-lock\.yaml)'; then echo 'BLOCK: this command would modify a protected file (.env*, pnpm-lock.yaml); use pnpm install or ask' >&2; exit 2; fi; exit 0

PATH="/usr/local/bin:/opt/homebrew/bin:$PATH"; command -v jq >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo 'format hook: jq missing, file not formatted' >&2; exit 2; }; f=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty'); root="${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-$PWD}"; case "$f" in "$root"/*) ;; *) exit 0;; esac; case "$f" in *.ts|*.tsx|*.js|*.jsx|*.mjs|*.cjs|*.json|*.md|*.css|*.yml|*.yaml) [ -s "$HOME/.nvm/nvm.sh" ] && . "$HOME/.nvm/nvm.sh" >/dev/null 2>&1; command -v pnpm >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo "format hook: pnpm not on PATH, $f not formatted" >&2; exit 2; }; pnpm exec prettier --write "$f" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true;; esac; exit 0
